title: racosperma gibbosum
intro: Racosperma gibbosum, commonly known as the Cassia absus, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating fever, rheumatism, and as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Racosperma gibbosum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
